rounds.text: The valuation is heavily extended, with the stock trading at a P/E of 27.4x [E1] and sitting right at 100% of its 52-week range [E48], showing zero distance from its 52-week high [E49]. This price action is drastically outrunning fundamentals, as 5-year share price growth of 43% exceeds profit growth of 31% [E56], and recent price growth exceeds profit growth by 55%, indicating that expectations are racing far ahead of actual delivery [E57]. Furthermore, key valuation multiples carry a clear premium over sector benchmarks, with a P/E of 25.95x against a sector benchmark of 23.17x [E6], a P/B of 6.17x versus a 2.63x sector benchmark [E7], and an EV/EBITDA of 16.69x compared to 14.07x [E11]. Beneath this momentum lie operational inconsistencies, highlighted by a yearly and quarterly operating-margin trend that reads inconsistent [E32, E33], alongside explicit warnings that earnings growth is decelerating [E68]. Buyers at these elevated levels also inherit substantial historical downside risk, given that the worst peak-to-trough drawdown on record stands at a severe -71.5% alongside an annualized volatility of 57.5% [E53, E54]. Conceded: the company maintains a strong return on capital employed of 30.8% [E12] and has successfully reduced its borrowings to zero [E39].
